description:
The presentation 'Q3_Global_Sales_Report.odp' has been assembled from multiple sources, resulting in inconsistent slide formatting (different background colors). Your task is to standardise the presentation by applying the 'Corporate Blue' master slide used on Slide 1 to ALL other slides in the deck.

1. Identify the master slide used by Slide 1 ('Q3 Sales Overview').
2. Apply this same master slide to Slides 2, 3, 4, and 5 so they all share the uniform blue background.
3. Save the presentation.
